title: LMLineage: Content Lineage and Context Governance for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.22511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interpretability for AI agents should not be confined to understanding the model's internal weights. It must also cover the agent's reasoning and decision-making process over multi-source context. We present LMLineage, an out-of-band system that attributes every output sentence of an agent session to its supporting input spans with calibrated confidences, without requiring white-box access to the model or any additional inference passes. On top of the lineage metadata, we build concept-drift micro compaction: instead of waiting for the context-length limit and summarizing everything, the system detects when previously used input documents have stopped being referenced ("drifted") and surgically compacts only those, preserving user instructions verbatim. translated_title: LMLineage：面向大语言模型智能体的内容溯源与上下文治理
translated_abstract: 对AI智能体的可解释性不应仅局限于理解模型的内部权重，还必须覆盖智能体在多源上下文之上的推理与决策过程。我们提出了LMLineage，这是一种带外（out-of-band）系统，能够将智能体会话中的每一句输出归因到其所依据的输入片段，并给出经过校准的置信度，且无需对模型的白盒访问权限，也无需任何额外的推理过程。在溯源元数据的基础上，我们构建了概念漂移微压缩（concept-drift micro compaction）机制：系统不再等到上下文长度达到上限后将所有内容进行摘要压缩，而是检测先前使用的输入文档何时不再被引用（即发生“漂移”），并仅对这部分文档进行精准压缩，同时逐字保留用户指令。我们在一个多层级的语料库上进行了评估：包括来自10个中文网页问答案例的71条黄金标注句子，以及跨三个生成器模型独立收集的90轮多轮会话……
tldr: LMLineage是一个无需模型白盒访问、无需额外推理的带外溯源系统，可将智能体输出的每句话归因到输入片段并给出校准置信度，并基于溯源元数据实现概念漂移微压缩，仅精准压缩不再被引用的输入文档同时逐字保留用户指令。
en_tdlr: LMLineage is an out-of-band system that attributes every agent output sentence to its supporting input spans with calibrated confidence—requiring no white-box model access or extra inference passes—and builds concept-drift micro compaction on top of the lineage metadata, surgically compacting only drifted input documents while preserving user instructions verbatim.
